name: Hayabusa Miwa
source:
A very mild-mannered and compassionate woman in her late 20s.

She has been a maid for the Kouno family for more than 10 years, and has a modest and graceful manner. She is devoted to the main character and Sayuki, but because she is a married woman, she sets limits on her services.

She will perform any kind of service to the main character and Sayuki as long as it is within the limits she has set for herself.
